description: Find a screen OODS Foundry generated at the pinned version: object and context pick one of the recorded object screens, and framework its React or Vue app. Returns the URL on oods-foundry.com where that built app runs, its recorded content hash, the brand and theme it was generated in, and the three calls that reproduce it with the local package (brand_create, design_compose, code_generate). Nothing is composed or generated here; a live preview of your own composition belongs to the local package. Use object_registry show instead to read the definition behind a screen.

context.description: The context the screen was composed for.

framework.description: The framework of the generated app.

object.description: An object with recorded screens at this version.

name: design_preview
title: Look Up Recorded Screen
